tweets.text: Las Vegas devs decided Satoshi's 1.1M coins will never be frozen — even as quantum computers loom. Those exposed keys are now the most expensive honeypot in history. The immutability debate is back, and it's existential.

Lightning just killed the update_fee deadlock — the single biggest cause of surprise force-closes. Zero-fee commitments via v3 TRUC are now merged into BOLTs. Unsexy protocol fix, massive real-world impact.

Iran strikes an oil tanker near the Strait of Hormuz, Brent crude touches $115, and Bitcoin... goes up. $4.45B in ETF inflows over 5 weeks. The "risk-off crypto selloff" playbook might be permanently broken.
Strive quietly crossed 15,000 BTC — $1.22 billion on the balance sheet. YTD BTC yield: 18.7%. Now the 11th largest public corporate holder. The treasury race isn't slowing down.
